name: EPIC 206129788
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 13.8 solar radii and 0.78 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206129788 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.754212 (16th-84th percentiles 13.399546-14.336641), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,581 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.78 solar masses and 13.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,690 K at its surface.
